name: Pampanga Marathon 2026
short_description: A 2026 road race in Angeles City / Clark, Pampanga, offering marathon, half marathon, 10km, and 5km distances.
ai_summary: The Pampanga Marathon 2026 is a road race scheduled for September 13, 2026, at the CDC Clark Parade Grounds in Angeles City / Clark, Pampanga, Philippines. Organized by SMOKE10 Events, it offers four distance options: a full marathon (42.195 km), a half marathon (21.1 km), 10 km, and 5 km. Registration details have not yet been announced.
pros: Multiple distance options (5km, 10km, half marathon, full marathon) suit a range of runner abilities

Organized by an established event organizer, SMOKE10 Events
cons: Registration status is not yet announced, so entry details are unavailable at this time
